info.title: Agents Trust API Search
info.description: Ask which paid API fits your task; get ranked candidates with URL, price, payment network, delivery evidence and risk flags. 0.01 USDC on Base or Solana. Free catalog lookups return catalog facts and public aggregates. Per-provider and per-endpoint scores, ranking diagnostics and paid delivery evidence are available through paid Inspect.

get.summary: Find ranked x402 APIs for a task, with price, payment network, invocation details and live payment-challenge checks.
get.description: Ranked paid APIs for your task: URL, price, network, delivery evidence, risk flags. 0.01 USDC. Costs 0.01 USDC over x402 outside the free demo set. A verified non-demo search with one or more recommendations returns its answer before settlement completes. Read x-at-payment-attempt-id from the paid 200 and use the free /receipt route for the eventual result. Empty results, invalid, rate-limited and unavailable searches are not settled. Every scalar parameter must appear once. Payment challenge evidence does not verify paid delivery.

parameters.name: need
parameters.description: A phrase describing the required work, with at least two letters or digits. The limit counts Unicode characters in the original input, including whitespace. Accepted text is normalized without truncation and matched against indexed endpoint descriptions. The free demo needs (weather, crypto prices, web search) may change. Maximum 300 characters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of picks. Fewer results are returned when evidence is insufficient.

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Only live=1 is supported. Returned picks do not always have a current payment challenge. Free demo needs (weather, crypto prices, web search) can skip this check, as can paid answers. Unconstrained picks may use a positive stored liveness probe within 72 hours or remain unknown after a bounded fallback. Explicit chain or price filters require a validated challenge. A pick without a validated challenge has payment_preflight.status=not_checked, has_valid_recent_challenge=false and selected_offer=null. Read liveness_source, liveness_checked_at and payment_preflight.checked_at; none verifies paid delivery.

parameters.name: max_price_usd
parameters.description: Maximum nominal USD price of the selected provider offer. Separate from the 0.01 USDC recommendation fee. The provider challenge at call time is authoritative.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Provider payment network in CAIP-2 form, such as eip155:8453. This does not identify the blockchain analyzed by the service.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response view: legacy, compact or evidence.

200.description: Completed search with zero or more recommendations. A verified paid answer arrives before settlement completes; poll /receipt using x-at-payment-attempt-id. The answer has no PAYMENT-RESPONSE header.

x-at-payment-attempt-id.description: Opaque ID for the free /receipt lookup on a paid answer

x-at-request-id.description: Server-generated id for this HTTP exchange. A 402 and its paid retry carry different ids. Record it; never send it.

402.description: Payment is required or a signed authorization was already claimed. The body is empty. Bare unsigned GETs return discovery quotes only: need is required for /recommend and url for /inspect. Supply the required input and obtain that request's quote before signing. Signed calls without required input are refused before payment verification or settlement; empty or partially specified input returns 400. A valid non-demo request made without payment returns a quote, not a paid answer. Bazaar output examples are illustrative, not search results. The x402 v2 challenge is the base64 encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header, not the body, and it carries the signed at-payment-attempt extension. Decode the header and record extensions["at-payment-attempt"].info.paymentAttemptId and leave the extension unchanged in the paid retry. It expires after 300 seconds.
